{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"

data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
test_row = data.loc[1, 'revenue_clean']
print(f"Sample converted revenue: {test_row}")"}
